title: This Free AI Tool Does What ChatGPT Can't
angle: ChatGPT has a hidden wall — and one free tool quietly destroys it. Most people don't know it exists yet.

scenes.voiceover: I asked ChatGPT this one question. It refused. So I tried THIS instead.
scenes.visual_description: ChatGPT screen with a blunt refusal message. Red X flashes over it. Hard cut to a clean rival UI loading fast.
scenes.caption_overlay: ChatGPT said NO. This said YES.

scenes.voiceover: It's called Perplexity AI. It's free. And it does something ChatGPT literally cannot do.
scenes.visual_description: Tool name slams onto screen in bold. FREE badge animates in. Checkmarks pop next to each capability.
scenes.caption_overlay: FREE. No login wall. No paywall.

scenes.voiceover: ChatGPT's knowledge cuts off. This tool searches the live internet IN REAL TIME. Right now. Today.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: ChatGPT returning outdated info vs Perplexity pulling today's headlines with live source links.
scenes.caption_overlay: LIVE internet vs. 2023 cutoff. Not even close.

scenes.voiceover: Breaking news, stock prices, live research — it cites every source. ChatGPT just guesses.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid cuts: live query results, clickable source citations, news timestamps from today, researcher nodding approvingly.

scenes.voiceover: If you're still using only ChatGPT, you're working with yesterday's internet. Stop that.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up face reacting with disbelief. Text counter ticking up showing how many queries happen per second on Perplexity.
scenes.caption_overlay: You're already behind. Fix it now.

scenes.voiceover: Go ask it the question ChatGPT refused. You'll see exactly what I mean. Link in bio.
scenes.visual_description: Returns to the original ChatGPT refusal screen, then whip-pans to Perplexity answering it perfectly. Loop implied.

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using the 'X refused but THIS did it' format on TikTok consistently hit 10M+ views. Example: multiple ChatGPT vs rival tool comparison videos in 2023-2024 averaging 12-40M views. The refusal-then-reveal structure exploits pattern interruption and forbidden-knowledge curiosity loops.
hook_test.why_it_works: The refusal frame triggers psychological reactance — viewers want what they're told they can't have. Adding 'free' removes the cost barrier objection instantly, and the live-internet differentiator is a concrete, demonstrable proof point that validates the claim visually in seconds.
